verdict.rationale: Supported CPU architectures are a fair question for an on-device inference engine like Cactus, so the axis applies. However, the documented platforms are limited to Arm and x86 on macOS/Linux and x64/Arm64 on Windows. Nothing in the pack mentions PowerPC, RISC-V or any other architecture beyond x86 and ARM, and the general 'any hardware' marketing line does not establish such support.
